name: Tunisia

flag.description: A red field with a white disc in the centre containing a red crescent that encircles a red five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: Red recalls the blood of the martyrs and white peace; the crescent and star are symbols of Islam and the country's Ottoman heritage.

hook: Tunisia keeps its red crescent and star inside a white disc in the centre; Turkey's white crescent floats freely toward the hoist.
trivia: The flag dates from 1831 under Hussein II Bey, making it one of the oldest national flags still in use; its exact proportions were standardised in 1999.
The desert planet Tatooine in Star Wars is named after the Tunisian town of Tataouine, and scenes were filmed in southern Tunisia.
